themes.evidence: build and govern BI content in Tableau and Redash — curated data sources, certified dashboards, and reusable metrics
Partner directly with stakeholders to translate business questions into data requirements
Design, build, and maintain our semantic layer using Snowflake semantic views
Comfortable with Git, command line, and CI/CD best practices
reduce dashboard sprawl through consolidation and clear standards

archetype_rationale: Day-to-day is dimensional modeling, dbt/SQL transformation, semantic-layer builds, and governed BI in Tableau/Redash — 'Transform raw data into high-quality data models' and 'Expert understanding of data warehousing concepts... dimensional modeling, star schemas.' No agentic or ML-building work despite the team's 'AI center of excellence' framing.
notes: JD mentions the team includes 'AI builders' and is a 'data and AI center of excellence', but this role itself has zero AI/LLM responsibilities — do not lead resume with agent work; lead with semantic layer (Kanu's customer-voice-semantic-layer artifact is a direct hit), dbt/SQL/Snowflake, governed dashboards, and stakeholder metric definition. Privacy/sensitive-data management and mentorship are secondary signals worth one bullet each.
